# Hudson Turansky

> Builder who uses AI to make tools for finance, plus agents, automations, and custom software. Learning markets by shipping in them.

Hudson Turansky is a builder. AI is the work, whether that is AI tools, agents, automations, or custom software. His current focus is finance: he is early in the field, studying for the SIE, and learning markets by building tools for them. The way he frames it, he is a custom builder for finance, where you bring the domain knowledge and he brings the ability to build it and get it shipped.

Live site: https://hudsonturansky.com
Email: hudsonturansky@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://hudsonturansky.com/): Who Hudson is, what he is building, and how to get in touch.
- [Builds](https://hudsonturansky.com/builds): Projects and a live AI meeting-assistant demo, plus the kinds of work he does: AI agents and assistants, automations and integrations, operations software, and web.
- [Finance Tools](https://hudsonturansky.com/finance-tools): Free finance tools, 3 free runs each. The first is the Filing Summarizer.
- [Filing Summarizer](https://hudsonturansky.com/finance-tools/filing-summarizer): Turns a company's latest SEC filing (10-K or 10-Q) into a plain-English one-page brief: key numbers, what changed, risks, and a jargon glossary. Pulls the filing from SEC EDGAR. 3 free runs per email, with the option to receive the brief as a PDF.
- [Updates](https://hudsonturansky.com/updates): Building in public. Short notes on what he is making and learning.
- [Resources](https://hudsonturansky.com/resources): Free tools and plain-English writing on AI and finance.
- [Free Personalized AI Brief](https://hudsonturansky.com/ai-brief): Answer a few questions about your work and life and get 6 to 10 specific AI use-case ideas, grouped "At Work" and "In Your Life" and tagged by effort. One brief per email.

## Resources

- [Is your data safe when you use AI?](https://hudsonturansky.com/resources/is-your-data-safe-with-ai): A plain-English guide to what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot actually do with your data, which tier protects you, the real risks, and the defensive moves that do not require a security team.
- [A plain-English AI glossary](https://hudsonturansky.com/resources/ai-glossary): The dozen-or-so AI terms that actually matter, each with a plain definition, why you would care, and whether it affects a real decision.

## What Hudson builds

- AI agents and assistants: custom tools built on models like Claude and Gemini. MCP and CLI agents, chatbots, research assistants, document processors, and workflow agents.
- Automation and integrations: scripts, bots, and pipelines that connect tools and automate repetitive work. Python or Node.
- Operations software: full-stack internal apps. Admin panels, client portals, CRMs, and ops dashboards.
- Web: landing pages, business sites, and internal dashboards.

## About

Hudson is a builder working with AI, now focused on finance. He is early in the field and studying for the SIE, and he wants to learn markets from the people who know them while doing what he is already good at: turning an idea into something that actually works. If you work in finance and need things built, get in touch.
